research_notes: Blocked for public/private headline years: nonpolitical dry-cleaning and financial-planning work has no usable dates/FTE. Official, member, employer and public professional sources checked.
The profile's volunteer dates improve the timeline but are excluded. No gated employment section was accessed.

Some narrative biographies place union work before the adviser role; official dated intervals are preferred without inventing a separate early SDA spell. Need employer/CV evidence for unresolved early work.
Follow-up2026-10-02: historical2014/2017/2019 employer reports recover exact vice-chair period, committee chair role and independent board resignation evidence. Finance employer remains unnamed.

Own first speech reviewed: represented7-Eleven workers; did not claim employment at7-Eleven. Father/grandfather manufacturing careers not imported.2020 local interview names Debonaires as current dry-cleaning supplier, not teenage employer. Italian municipal/accountancy namesakes rejected.

Next leads: finance employer or public CV, university/Collins/financial-work sequence and working hours; identify teenage dry cleaner. Keep historical governance control unknown pending constitution/appointment powers; public funding alone insufficient. All headline values remain null.

Third follow-up3October2026: targeted searches under Raff and Raffaele for the financial-planning employer, adviser sequence and teenage dry cleaner produced no reliable employer name, dates or hours. The current first-person member biography narrates SDA work before the Collins adviser role, while APH gives adviser2008–2013 then SDA2013–2019 and the2020 local interview places financial planning after graduation; the conflict is preserved rather than reordered. No new appointment, full-time or governance-control evidence was found; nonmaterial follow-up recorded and headline totals remain null.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: a first-person2020 workplace article materially narrows the teenage employer to a dry cleaner inside Chadstone Shopping Centre and calls it his first job. The legal business name, dates and hours remain unresolved, and a current supplier mentioned elsewhere was not conflated with the former employer. Exact-name finance/adviser searches produced no financial-planning employer or safer work sequence; unrelated overseas namesakes were rejected.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Added four omitted qualifications and four party volunteer offices using official biography, own member site and visible professional-profile sections. ICDA2016–2017 dates attach to named institution; unlabeled2002–2006/2007 rows are not assigned to degrees. Local graduation2008 claim remains unallocated. Finance-employer searches under Raff/Raffaele returned no reliable entity or contract; modern Swinburne visits and represented7-Eleven workers are not personal employers. Existing Collins/SDA narrative order conflict retained. Next dated finance CV and contracts, dry-cleaner identity, degree conferral and staff/study overlaps.

Fifth follow-up 5 October 2026: targeted Raff/Raffaele finance-employer and first dry-cleaning-job searches in both engines recovered the already preserved personal Chadstone account and broad finance-to-industrial-work narrative only. Banking interests and represented retail/fast-food workers are not personal bank or hospitality employment. Current Debonaires customer relationship and a Gazette list of dry-cleaning businesses do not identify the teenage employer. ICDA graduate profile corroborates known study but supplies no finance employment dates. No original finance contract/CV, dry-cleaner payroll identity, paid fraction or leave record was recovered. Financial-planning overlap with Collins official 2008–2013 service and narrative ordering remains unresolved. Useful future avenues are an original legitimately public dated professional profile, employer appointment record and conferral evidence; no sector/hours or headline totals invented.

Second targeted primary pass5October2026: re-read original Link2016–17 director biography,printedp4/PDFindex5,which independently refers to financial-sector and federal-government roles but still supplies no financial-planning company, contract dates or hours. Committee-attendance table and pooled benefits are not personal full-time salary evidence; leave note27September2016 belongs to Anne Crawford, not Ciccone. Exact-name finance and Collins research queries again return known alumni/local profiles and parliamentary committee staff belonging to other people. Preserved official2008–2013 adviser interval and unresolved finance/study ordering rather than rewriting from broad narrative. No new employment/control/hours fact; next original dated finance CV or payroll appointment and personally mapped conferral documentation.
